description: This file defines the Action class within the OpenCart framework, responsible for encapsulating actions that can be executed within the system. It manages routing to controllers and methods, and handles execution logic, including validation and error handling.

classes.name: Action
classes.description: Represents a specific action in the OpenCart system that can be executed, including route parsing, controller method invocation, and validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an Action object with a route string, sanitizing it and extracting controller and method names.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the route string associated with this action.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the stored action using the provided registry and arguments, handling errors and calling the controller method.
